title: Understanding inspiration: Insights into how designers discover inspirational stimuli using an AI-enabled platform

context_summary: The paper investigates how designers search for inspirational stimuli using an AI-enabled multi-modal search platform. It explores the impact of search modalities on design behaviors and the rationale behind designers' evaluation and selection of search results.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not include pure automatic indicators, objective performance, logs, simulations, author discussions, citations of existing research, or future research plans.
